environment.description: Same EC2 instance and application WAR deployed identically, but the instance security group restricts inbound TCP 8080 to the prefix list pl-3b927c52 (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing) only. A CloudFront distribution (E1A2B3C4D5E6F7) is configured with Origin Access settings requiring signed URLs with a 300-second TTL using key group kg-0a1b2c3d4e5f6 (RSA 2048-bit key pair, private key stored in Secrets Manager). The CloudFront distribution has a cache behavior for /api/v1/import/* with AllowedMethods POST restricted, viewer protocol policy redirect-to-https, and origin request policy that forwards X-Session-Id header but strips all other custom headers. The CloudFront distribution's origin configuration uses a custom origin with HTTPS-only origin protocol policy to the instance's private DNS. Additionally, the instance metadata service is configured with HttpTokens=required (IMDSv2 only) and HttpPutResponseHopLimit=1.

config.security_group_ingress: TCP 8080 from pl-3b927c52 (CloudFront origin-facing IPs only)
